evals.name: fixture-backed-two-sprite-extraction
evals.prompt: Use the attached tiny atlas and reviewed region JSON. Extract the two logical sprites into a new output directory, preserve the supplied name for the first and stable numbering for the unnamed second, then report validation evidence.
evals.expected_output: Runs deterministic extraction against the explicit regions, produces red-token.png and sprite-002.png plus manifest.json, verifies RGBA mode, alpha-tight edges, hashes, bounds, grouping, and stable order, and reports the actual command outcome.

assertions.text: Uses the attached region specification instead of inventing semantic segmentation
Produces red-token.png, sprite-002.png, and manifest.json in the requested new directory
Runs the independent verifier and reports its real result

evals.name: touching-pair-and-detached-spark
evals.prompt: This sheet has two touching fruit slices that should stay together, plus a one-pixel sparkle belonging to them. Prepare the region plan and extraction settings without splitting the pair or dropping the sparkle.
evals.expected_output: Creates one logical region for the touching pair, records the grouping decision, uses all components with a local minimum component area suitable for the assigned sparkle, and requires visual review of both the sprite edge and detached effect.

assertions.text: Keeps the touching pair as one named logical sprite and records why
Uses a local component-area override for the assigned tiny effect rather than weakening every region
Does not claim that touching or hidden pixels were semantically reconstructed

evals.name: adjacent-atlas-packing-request
evals.prompt: I already have 40 separate transparent character PNGs. Pack them into the smallest power-of-two texture atlas and emit CSS coordinates.
evals.expected_output: Routes away from this skill because the request combines existing files into an atlas rather than decomposing one raster into separate sprites.

assertions.text: Does not invoke the decomposition workflow or produce extraction regions

evals.name: loads-region-review-for-ambiguous-fringes
evals.prompt: The source has pale glows, soft shadows, tiny petals, and a gently changing cream background. Decide how to author and review the region JSON before extracting anything.
evals.expected_output: Reads references/region-review.md, selects the quadratic background route, keeps per-region grouping and component decisions explicit, and describes a light/dark-background review loop without treating thresholds as universal constants.

assertions.text: Captured trace records a read of references/region-review.md before the region plan is finalized
Uses symptom-led threshold tuning and explicit particle assignment from the review reference

evals.name: safe-rerun-and-process-evidence
evals.prompt: The output folder already exists from yesterday. Rerun the extraction safely and tell me exactly what proves the new files are complete and the source stayed unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Refuses the default clobber path, requires explicit overwrite intent, stages and verifies the complete replacement, checks the source hash, and reports manifest inventory, PNG hashes, dimensions, RGBA mode, and transparent-edge tightness.

assertions.text: Does not replace an existing output directory without the explicit overwrite flag
Publishes only after staged verification and unchanged-source evidence
Declares completion only after the independent verify command passes

evals.name: occluded-sprite-limit
evals.prompt: Two characters overlap in this flattened sheet. Separate both and reconstruct the covered arm and leg so each becomes a complete animation cel.
evals.expected_output: Explains that extraction can preserve only visible pixels, refuses to claim hidden-pixel recovery, and offers reviewed visible-region extraction if that reduced result is useful.

assertions.text: States that hidden pixels cannot be recovered from the flattened source
Does not fabricate the covered anatomy or call the result a complete reconstruction
